level.reason: not standard: 1 PRs (need at least 3); 100% of pushes on the trunk (need under 20%); 0% of commits after a test command (need at least 50%)

findings.meaning: Pushes go straight to the trunk; main-commit-gate blocks that from day one. A shifting trunk (release/rN) clashes with one fixed default branch.

proposal.text: Pick one fixed trunk (main) and work on a branch per issue.

findings.meaning: Work outside issues does not fit the chain from issue to PR.

proposal.text: Install the issue labels so issues and PRs carry the chain.

findings.meaning: An index at the read limit is partly ignored, and lighthouse writes nothing to harness memory.

proposal.text: Clean up auto-memory; a rule that must last belongs in the repo.

findings.meaning: Shows whether Claude Code runs on native Windows, WSL or Linux, which decides the install block of the guide.

proposal.text: Line endings caused trouble; add a .gitattributes with `* text=auto eol=lf`.

findings.meaning: Shows which hooks block tool calls and which project hooks may duplicate a lighthouse hook.

proposal.text: No overlap found; run /lighthouse-audit-agent-config for a full audit of the hooks.

findings.meaning: Shows where worktrees are made; worktrees in a synchronisation folder give lock and copy problems.

proposal.text: Keep worktrees outside synchronisation folders, for example under ~/.claude/worktrees.
